items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-20
items.q: And in that group, we had Almond Kay... And we had Jerry Bouquet on clarinet... myself, string bass.

ctx.x: And who was in Almond Kay's band?

Almond Kay had a fine little group at the Fountain Blue Hotel here on Tulane and Calton. And we played in the La Chondelle Lounge there for about nine months, I think, close to ten months. And in that group, we had Almond Kay, the band leader, and the trumpet man, plays fine trumpet. And we had Jerry Bouquet on clarinet, antenna saxophone, and flute, very fine musician. And we had Joe Clark on drums. And we had Bob Doyle on piano. And Bob plays marvelous piano, very fine piano man. He and I used to work together…
When did you switch to this electronic type bass?
